breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly specified applying the torque-induced load as a fixed global-x traction vector. The ground truth corrects this by explicitly stating to 'Apply the traction in the local tangent direction... do not replace it by a fixed global x or y vector.' The Agent's generated specification repeated the original error by stating: 'The traction on the loaded arc shall be applied as a fixed Cartesian vector (t_θ, 0) = (6366.2, 0) N/m...'
